public_internet_webrtc_relay_route.requirement: real macOS and Android peers select a deployed remote TURN relay WebRTC route over a genuine public Internet path

real_media_continuity.requirement: real ScreenCaptureKit/CGDisplayStream frames reach Android MediaCodec through the WebRTC relay session

secure_record_layer.requirement: Phase 3 AES-256-GCM application records are used above WebRTC with session/key/channel separation and no plaintext fallback

source_current_base.requirement: manifest source commit matches a clean current checkout

webrtc_transport.requirement: control and media bytes crossed WebRTC DataChannels or media channels, not trusted-LAN TCP or USB fallback

limitations: No public Internet WebRTC/TURN relay product E2E pass is claimed.
Relay deployment preflight hardening is not product E2E evidence.
Local loopback, forced local coturn, synthetic peers, synthetic media, USB, and trusted-LAN records are readiness evidence only.

cross_service_revocation.requirement: Authority, signaling, TURN credential issuance, and active allocation all fail closed after revoke

external_camera_latency.requirement: direct and relay Internet paths have external-camera glass-to-glass latency evidence

network_handoff.requirement: public route handoff recovers with a fresh session and old-record rejection

packet_capture_confidentiality.requirement: direct and relay packet captures show no plaintext content, credentials, or pairing secrets

relay_production_prerequisites.requirement: production relay DNS, /readyz, disk, TLS, quota, and secret-source checks pass

two_hour_mixed_route_soak.requirement: two-hour mixed direct/relay/network-change soak has bounded queues, memory, nonce, latency, and media behavior
